title: [master] Report 400 (Remittance Advice) Does Not Include Applied Vendor Refund Entries Resulting in Incorrect Total Calculation
summary: Report 400 now includes applied vendor refund entries that share a payment's document number, ensuring the report lines match the total amount instead of showing a discrepancy.
key_points: Vendor refunds with matching document numbers now appear as separate lines on the remittance advice report
The total calculation is adjusted to prevent double-counting refunds already listed as lines
Payment discount logic is skipped for refund entries to avoid incorrect calculations
Both PEPPOL export and standard remittance advice report logic updated consistently
quote: A vendor refund sharing a payment's document number isn't shown as a line on Report 400
